event.distribution_pattern: US states: AZ, CA, IL, NE, and TX. No international distribution.

products.product_description: Su-Nun Crushed Roasted Thai Red Pepper, 10.58 oz. 12 jars/case. Packaged in clear plastic jars, red plastic screw on lid, with a red and yellow label. The principal display label has a red background with a yellow oval that reads in part:"SU-NUN***BRAND***HOT***CRUSHED ROASTED THAI RED PEPPER". Label on the back reads in part:"MANUFACTURED BY KHUN NAN CURRY PASTE FACTORY 149/375 Moo 13, Soi Pacific, Settakit Road, omm-Noi, Kratumband, Samutsakhon, 74130, Thailand***". No expiration date listed.
products.code_info: No lot codes. Only UPC code: 659613000770. Distribution dates July 2012 to October 2012. No expiration date listed.
products.reason_for_recall: The recall was initiated in response to positive Salmonella resuts during FDA routine import sampling of the product.
